allInOne.heroBefore: Turnkey home building means the client signs with a single construction partner that carries out
allInOne.heroHighlight: the whole project, from A to Z
allInOne.heroAfter: . That partner handles every stage - survey, design, construction, installation of building equipment - and manages the work on site directly. When it is finished, the client simply takes over the completed home and moves in.
allInOne.heroCompany: Chính Nam Design & Construction JSC was founded in 2012. Today it is considered one of the leading design and construction firms in Đồng Nai. Over more than 13 years, with an experienced, highly skilled and dedicated team, Chính Nam keeps raising the quality of its design and construction work to deliver the best solutions for our clients - so that every client feels secure, satisfied and happy, from the first design idea through construction and into life in their happy home.

benefits.title: Saves your time and effort
benefits.text: With a turnkey solution the owner does not have to spend time and effort supervising and following the work on site. Everything to do with the build is managed by Chính Nam professionally and to a set process, so the owner can relax and save time.

benefits.title: Keeps the budget under control
benefits.text: A turnkey solution lets you control the total construction cost effectively. You do not have to worry about unpredictable costs or sudden increases during construction.

benefits.title: A design that fits the family, sound in engineering and in aesthetics
benefits.text: Your home is balanced in its spaces and complete in its functions, following your needs and taste, and expressing your standing.

benefits.title: One consistent build, from design through to finishing
benefits.text: Every item and every detail is looked after and closely supervised, carried out to process and guaranteeing the quality and durability of the work.

benefits.title: A schedule you can count on
benefits.text: Construction and handover follow the schedule agreed and committed to in the contract.

allInOne.benefitsClosing: Choosing a turnkey, key-in-hand solution saves you time, effort and money, while securing the quality and the schedule of your home in the best possible way.
allInOne.processIntro: Nine steps, from the first consultation to the completion filings: each one with its own tasks and timeframe.

steps.title: First contact (online or in person), design consultation and design contract
items: Recording and completing the client's information
A consultation in person (building density, indicative budget, first hand sketches setting the design direction around the client's needs and wishes)
Signing the contract + surveying the site

steps.title: 2D layout design
items: Based on your needs and the condition of the site
Designing the floor plan and the layout of the functions
Presenting the 2D layout + a 3D massing model, explained at the Chính Nam office
Signing off the layout and moving on to the 3D exterior design

steps.title: 3D exterior design
steps.note: Timeframe: 5 – 15 days depending on the scale of the project
items: Working from the approved plan, Chính Nam proposes a 3D exterior that suits both the functions and the budget
Presenting the 3D exterior
Signing off the 3D design and moving on to the basic design

steps.title: Basic design & revisions to the design file
steps.note: Timeframe: 5 – 20 days depending on the scale of the project
items: Once the 2D and 3D designs are agreed, Chính Nam produces the basic design for two purposes: the building permit, and the quotation for the “structural labour and materials” package
Presenting the design and agreeing the technical positions (septic tank, switches and sockets, structural system, etc.)
After that presentation, the owner reviews the whole basic design file and sends feedback to Chính Nam for updating

steps.title: Interior design and adjustments
items: Presenting and explaining the 2D layout: 5 - 10 working days
Designing, presenting and explaining the 3D scheme: 10 - 30 working days (depending on the scale of the project)
Producing the detailed drawings: 10 - 30 working days (depending on the scale of the project)

steps.title: Completing and handing over the design file
items: Handing over the technical construction drawings and the cost estimate
Signing the contract settlement at the Chính Nam office
The permit file is given to the owner once the authorities respond

steps.title: Construction contract and start of works
items: Structural works
Finishing works
Interior fit-out

steps.title: Inspection and handover
items: Checks and inspections run throughout construction and are carried out for each detailed task and each item of the works, as required by construction law and to the Vietnamese standards for each item inspected.
Handover, instructions for use and support afterwards: throughout your life in your “happy home”, Chính Nam stays alongside you.

Whenever you need support, please contact our client care team on 0944 454 199 - (0251) 7 301 139, and Chính Nam will advise the best solution - one that saves cost without damaging the original architecture.

steps.title: Completion filings
items: It does not end at handover and warranty: the last stage of a turnkey build is the completion filing.
Chính Nam advises and helps the owner prepare the procedures and legal documents required by law, so the project is finished in full.

schedule.title: Structural works
schedule.text: The structure is the most important part of any build. It is the stage that shapes the house - columns, beams, slabs - and gives it its strength. Structural work (labour and materials) follows the design file and covers:
items: Foundations
Ground beams and foundation beams
Columns
Concrete beams and floor slabs on every storey
Building and rendering all the walls
The roof

rows.task: Columns → beams and slabs per storey
Columns → beams and slabs per storey

schedule.title: Finishing works
schedule.text: With the structure done, the house is 70% complete. Next comes finishing - the stage that dresses the house in the style the family wants.
items: Waterproofing
Tiling and stonework
Plasterboard ceilings
Painting
Fitting doors and balustrades…

designConsult.heroText: Design is the step that decides your future home - how it works, how it looks, and what it costs to build.
designConsult.introHeading: A home is where memories are made
intro: As society moves on, a home is asked to be more than shelter at the end of a hard day: it is where memories are made with the people closest to you, and where you recover your energy each day. Those memories and experiences connect the members of a family, nurture their affection for one another and shape who they become.

Design is a critical step in preparing the home you will live in. It lets you forecast and control the costs, the materials, the time and the labour the build will take. Designing means researching, drawing inspiration and finding creative answers - answers that are beautiful, that suit how the house will be used, and above all that carry the owner's own style and standing.
designConsult.statement: Over more than a decade, Chính Nam Design & Construction JSC has become a name trusted nationwide, with the mission of “Building A Home Of Happiness”: living spaces that are harmonious in feng shui, in beauty and in durability.
interior: Alongside the architecture outside and the well-planned layout that comes with the architectural design package, interior design takes the living space further still - in how it works and in how it looks.

The right interior sits in proportion with the architecture of the house and brings out its beauty. Every home has its own size and its own demands, its own owners, its own interior style, and its designer's own flexibility - together they make the one house that is truly yours.

legalSupport.heroTitle: The right paperwork, a lawful build
legalSupport.heroText: Chính Nam prepares the legal file for your project alongside you: the building permit, the notice of commencement, and the acceptance that puts the house into use.
legalSupport.overviewLabel: Legal basics for building a private home
legalSupport.overviewHeading: What does the legal file cover?
overview: The legal side of building a private home is the whole set of documents a house needs before, during and after construction under Vietnamese law. Each has to be confirmed, approved or issued by the competent authority for the project to be built lawfully. For a private home the file usually includes: the owner's land use right certificate (or documents of equivalent legal standing), the planning information, the building line, the building permit issued by the competent authority, the design file as required, and the documents covering construction and completion.

The firms taking part in the design, the construction and the supervision must also meet the capability requirements in force, so that the quality, the safety and the legal standing of the house hold throughout the build and the years of use that follow.
legalSupport.docsIntro: A project stands on solid legal ground when its paperwork is complete and approved by the competent authorities, with nothing outstanding.

howWeWork.intro: Chính Nam Design & Construction Co., Ltd. was founded on 22 November 2012, focusing on architectural design.

milestones.text: Chính Nam Design & Construction Co., Ltd. was founded on 22 November 2012, with architectural design as its main activity.
After three years, Chính Nam had essentially completed its organisation across both design and construction.
Carrying a mission to develop construction projects in Đồng Nai province while expanding to projects nationwide.
The company opened offices in 3 provinces and cities: Đồng Nai, Ho Chi Minh City and Tây Ninh.
The company was certified for the design, supervision and construction of Class II civil works and Class III industrial works.
Converted from a limited liability company into Chính Nam Design & Construction JSC, standardising its management and organisation systems (ISO 9000, Total Quality Management, etc.).
Marking 10 years of growth for Chính Nam Design & Construction JSC.
